definitions.explanation: A general term for any textile or material spread on the floor for comfort, decoration, or protection. Includes rugs, carpets, mats, and similar coverings.

examples.japanese: {敷物|しきもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧。
⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{敷物|しきもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a new mat at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ペルシャ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{敷物|しきもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高級品|こうきゅうひん}→高級品：21439_koukyuuhin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Persian rugs are known as luxury items.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (to spread, to lay) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). A broad term covering rugs, carpets, mats, and other floor coverings. In Japanese homes, this can include ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧ mats as well as Western-style carpets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敷物|しきもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (to lay a rug)
- {敷物|しきもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to change the floor covering)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カーペット→カーペット：24239_kaapetto⟧: carpet — specifically a Western-style wall-to-wall or area carpet
- ラグ: rug — a smaller decorative floor covering
- ⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧: mat — a smaller, often functional floor covering
